newsitem.title: USA: ROSS Tech chairman, CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: ROSS Tech chairman, CEO resigns.

text.p: ROSS Technology Inc said on Monday that Roger Ross has resigned as chairman, president and chief executive officer.
No reason for the resignation was given.

The board of directors appointed Fred May as chairman and acting president and chief executive officer, ROSS Technology said. The company has started a search for a new president and chief executive officer, it said.
Ross will continue as a member of the board, the company said.
